newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Credit bid-only after tie-up report.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Credit bid-only after tie-up report.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Credit Bank Ltd were bid-only early on Thursday morning after media reports that it is considering a capital and business tie-up with Bankers Trust New York Corp, trader said.
By 0023 GMT, NCB was bid-only at 173 yen, against its close on Wednesday of 168 yen.
In early Thursday morning, NCB said that it and Bankers Trust had agreed on a business alliance and that NCB would also consider a capital tie-up with the U.S. bank.
The two banks will sign the business tie-up agreement in late April, NCB and Bankers Trust said in a joint statement.
The tie-up is likely to help improve the financial health of NCB, which is in the course of a restructuring, brokers said.
